properties.description: Ever Gauzy is an open-source, all-in-one business management platform combining HR, CRM, project management, and back-office operations for agencies, studios, and small-to-medium businesses. It covers employee time tracking with activity monitoring and automated screenshots, invoicing and accounting, sales pipeline and proposal generation, recruitment and applicant tracking, inventory and production oversight, and multi-organization role-based permissions. Built as a TypeScript monorepo (NestJS backend, Angular frontend) with desktop apps for Windows/Mac/Linux and integrations like Upwork and Hubstaff.
